audit_skill: ARIS proof-checker local adaptation under Q7_WORKFLOW
summary: C6, Q, T, one prior56-edge residual witness and bridge-preserving22-edge completion reduction pass modulo explicit imports; full m2/R7/P7 remain open.

external_imports.name: Fink C0
external_imports.scope: Arbitrary K(Qd) perfect matching extends to Hamilton cycle with cube edges added; d=6,7

external_imports.name: HK82 Theorem2
external_imports.scope: Every inclusion-maximal Q6 matching has at least24 edges

obligations.subject: C6 domain
obligations.discharge: F is an arbitrary K(Q6) matching; cross-edge endpoint map phi is a genuine bijection, without a mirror or color assumption.

obligations.subject: C6 even crossing count
obligations.discharge: 32=2m_U+q+h_U and balanced holes imply q even, including long or same-color prescribed edges.

obligations.subject: C6 first local input
obligations.discharge: D pairs all and only X_U; F_U union D is a matching with exactly the original holes in U. Q5 all-hole cycle applies.

obligations.subject: C6 actual paths
obligations.discharge: Deleting the nonempty disjoint marked D edges from a single cycle yields q/2 vertex-disjoint spanning paths with precisely X_U as endpoints and no cycle component.

obligations.subject: C6 cross transport
obligations.discharge: Attach the unique original cross edge at every endpoint using phi. Interiors are in U and endpoints in X_V; all are pairwise disjoint.

obligations.subject: C6 second local input
obligations.discharge: The actual endpoint pairing R is a matching on X_V, disjoint from F_V; F_V union R has exactly original holes in V. Q5 cycle applies again.

obligations.subject: C6 expansion
obligations.discharge: Replacing marked R edges by disjoint actual paths preserves one cycle and inserts every U vertex exactly once. F_U,F_V and all original cross edges survive; only F edges may be long.

obligations.subject: C6 zero-cross with holes
obligations.discharge: Rename a face with holes U. An incident non-F_V edge at x* exists since F_V is a matching; it is short. Mirror target y* is opposite to free x; Q5 path allows covered targets.

obligations.subject: C6 zero-cross gluing and perfect case
obligations.discharge: Two disjoint spanning paths plus the two distinct mirror bridges form one spanning cycle. With no holes and q=0, F is perfect and C0 applies. Cases exhaust all q.

obligations.subject: R6 import discharge
obligations.discharge: For a short matching with a free root, P6 applies to a short neighbor target. The endpoint edge cannot lie in a 64-vertex simple path; adding it closes one cycle. Perfect input uses C0.

obligations.subject: Q outer parity
obligations.discharge: Four balanced Q5 hole blocks imply each Q6 face has balanced original holes. Internal short matching covers colors equally, so the outer ports have equal color counts and c is even.

obligations.subject: Q first C6 input
obligations.discharge: M_A union D has exactly H intersect A, because ports are covered by D and were not original holes. Its chosen two Q5 hole sets remain unchanged.

obligations.subject: Q actual outer pairing
obligations.discharge: After removing D every retained A edge is short; attaching original short cross edges creates disjoint actual short paths with distinct B endpoints.

obligations.subject: Q second C6 input
obligations.discharge: M_B union R has exactly H intersect B; its two Q5 hole sets remain balanced even if R is long or crosses the internal cut. C6 explicitly permits such R.

obligations.subject: Q final cycle and bridge count
obligations.discharge: Expansion produces a single 128-vertex short cycle containing all M. Only original C crosses the outer coordinate, hence exactly c outer bridges for c>0.

obligations.subject: Q zero-cross branches
obligations.discharge: With holes choose the face containing a free root, use R6 on the other face and P6 on the chosen face with a possibly covered opposite target; two bridges close. Without holes use d=7 C0.

obligations.subject: T all-input implication
obligations.discharge: Odd weight 1,3,5 leaves at least two fixed coordinates; translation by t fixes all four blocks and flips color. It pairs their holes bijectively, independently of matching symmetry.

obligations.subject: Single fixed input arithmetic
obligations.discharge: Independently reconstructed the 56 short disjoint edges, their 16 holes, direction counts, xor67 invariance, and fixed split (i,k)=(5,2). Four color counts are 2:2,2:2,1:1,3:3; c=20.

obligations.subject: Strict new coverage scope
obligations.discharge: The directly bound prior N audit explicitly certifies this witness is outside its listed rules including M and N. This imported exclusion plus Q/T witnesses strict new coverage relative to those rules only.

obligations.subject: Bridge-preserving completion
obligations.discharge: Greedy extension in each Q6 minus its two original bridge endpoints is finite, preserves M, keeps both endpoints free internally and produces an independent remaining hole set in that face.

obligations.subject: At most two further edges
obligations.discharge: When extending L_S in full Q6, every newly added edge touches the two retained endpoints because H_S was independent. Free sets only shrink, and disjoint new edges use at most two endpoints.

obligations.subject: HK82 input and bound
obligations.discharge: HK82 Theorem 2 states every inclusion-maximal Q6 matching has at least24 edges. Thus |L_S|>=24-2=22. Temporary endpoint-occupying edges are not put into L.

obligations.subject: Dense and opposite-color branches
obligations.discharge: Opposite-color ports allow P6 in each face with two free opposite endpoints. Same-color ports and any face internal size>=28 meet exactly imported F7, without a density condition on the other face.

obligations.subject: Residual counts
obligations.discharge: With both internal sizes22..27, |L|=|L_A|+|L_B|+2 is46..56, global holes16..36 and each face global holes62-2|L_S| is8..18. These are L holes, not numerical restrictions on the original M.

obligations.subject: Rich direction and independent scope
obligations.discharge: At least44 internal edges across six directions imply some direction has at least8 in total. Only facewise hole independence follows; neither global maximality nor a stitching condition follows.

obligations.subject: Back substitution and m2
obligations.discharge: Any cycle containing L contains M. Original bridge count remains exactly2 and all other direction counts do not decrease. Under the stated all-seven-directions-at-least2 hypothesis m stays2. Residual universal extension remains unproved.

obligations.subject: Dependencies and quantifiers
obligations.discharge: Q5+C0=>C6; P6+C0=>R6; C6+P6+R6+C0=>Q=>T. HK82=>completion bound; F7/P6=>closed branches. No R7/P7 reverse use; each choice is sequential after actual paths exist.

obligations.subject: Bindings and assurance
obligations.discharge: All24 author-manifest bindings pass; four direct accepted source bindings pass. Full R7/P7, full m2, seven-direction lifting and historical4228 remain open; no solver, family enumeration or large-certificate replay occurred.
